Ways to bring MDT to your school.

We're designing these with our first partner schools, so details will change. Here's what we're planning.

A weekly club, run by a teacher, powered by MDT.

Students work through a learning path together, one session a week, and finish the term with a project each.

  • check_circleOne learning path per term
  • check_circleSession guides for the teacher in charge
  • check_circleEnd-of-term project showcase

Two to four weeks of focused learning in the long holiday.

Keeps students learning while school is out, with a clear finish line and something to show for it.

  • check_circleDaily short sessions
  • check_circleMix of online learning and group check-ins
  • check_circleCertificates for students who finish

A one-week taster across several skills.

Ideal for career weeks or end-of-term activities. Students try a few areas and find what clicks.

  • check_circleFive short taster lessons
  • check_circleA mini project at the end
  • check_circleTalks from tutors where possible

Placeholder: pricing for schools, minimum group size and what each format includes.

For organisations.

Companies, NGOs, foundations and event organisers: help us connect teens with real opportunities.
